title: When Good OCR Is Not Enough: Benchmarking OCR Robustness for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Lin Sun; Wang Dexian; Jingang Huang; Linglin Zhang; Change Jia; Zhengwei Cheng; Xiangzheng Zhang
why_relevant: Introduces a benchmark showing how OCR-induced structural/semantic errors degrade RAG retrieval and generation, a form of upstream noisy/unreliable evidence in industrial RAG pipelines.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on OCR quality rather than retrieval robustness per se; narrower scope on document parsing noise.
